Each node carries statement, orientation, why_helps_parent, and promotion_note. Fully recoverable via nd tree / nd show.

leanings.detail: Every node stores a lean + confidence and a synthesized conclusion. Overall thesis (N-0001, mixed/medium): a 'third reading' beyond neutral-vs-lagged — the net effect is real, negative in direction, but currently concentrated and limited (youth/entry-level + automation-type high-exposure occupations), not yet an aggregate shock, and expanding over time. 'Neutral' and 'lag' are two incomplete facets of one phenomenon ('partly already realized, partly still releasing'). Branch leans: N-0002 mixed/high (task substitution real but bounded external validity); N-0003 mixed/high (resolution-dependent divergence); N-0004 mixed/medium (mechanism can fail when coverage broadens to whole workflows); N-0005 mixed/medium (lag real but likely IT-paradox scale ~single-digit-to-teens years, not electrification-scale decades); N-0006 mixed/medium (measurement blind spots real but not a single 'systematic masking' story). Leaf syntheses (SYN-0001..0015) each have summary + confidence + open_questions.

adversarial_lines.detail: Counter-arguments are first-class, tagged orientation='adversarial': N-0008 (pilot studies too controlled/early-adopter to extrapolate to economy-wide substitution rate); N-0010 (macro confounders — 2022-23 rate hikes / post-COVID / tech layoffs — tested and largely excluded via firm x time fixed effects since divergence only significant post-2024; plus REVERSE confound: AI-washing over-attributes layoffs to AI); N-0013 ('this time is different' — agents do end-to-end workflows like mobile-banking not ATM, so historical complementarity analogy may fail); N-0015 (is the lag hypothesis even falsifiable? — stress-tested against leading indicators, finds asymmetric signal); N-0017 (reverse-test of the statistical-masking hypothesis using independent high-freq Revelio/Ramp data, which points the OPPOSITE way). The entire N-0006 branch is a reverse-test of the 'mild data is an artifact' claim. Each records its counter-evidence and residual open_questions.
